messages.subject: backend capacity before the v3 push
messages.body:
my take: the backend team is now the bottleneck.

- api backlog is at ~3.5 weeks and growing
- jonas is solo on the scanner integration, zero slack
- the driver-sync work keeps slipping, which is on the critical path for v3

options as i see them:
1. one senior backend hire, can own sync + integrations from month two
2. two juniors, cheaper per head but needs me or jonas to babysit for months

I lean option 1 but it's a budget call. Marta, can we get this moving this week? Recruiting lead time matters.

Cheers, Dev

messages.subject: RE: backend capacity before the v3 push
messages.body:
Hi Dev, thank you for laying this out so clearly.

From a recruiting perspective: a senior backend profile in Rotterdam typically takes 8-10 weeks from opening to signed offer, so if we want someone productive before the summer crunch we should open the role soon. Two junior hires we could fill faster individually, but honestly the current market makes strong juniors scarce too, and I share Dev's concern about mentoring capacity - you two are already stretched.

I would gently suggest the senior route, but it does need a budget ceiling confirmed by Helen before I can post anything. Two juniors would come in around a similar total cost once onboarding time is included, so I don't see a real saving there.

Helen, could you confirm what headcount budget we have available?

Warm regards,
Ingrid Solberg
People & Culture, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: backend capacity before the v3 push
messages.body:
Dear all,

Thank you Ingrid for the context, and Dev for the analysis. Having reviewed the current headcount plan, I can confirm that we have room for one senior engineering hire at a budget of up to EUR 95,000 per annum, excluding the usual employer costs. I would gently suggest that we treat this as a firm ceiling for now, given the cash commitments we already carry this quarter (lease, migration spend, the launch itself).

If it transpires that two junior hires would be materially cheaper, I am of course happy to revisit, but I note that Ingrid's point about scarce junior talent rather undermines that argument.

Kind regards,
Helen Oyelaran
Chief Financial Officer, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: backend capacity before the v3 push
messages.body:
ok. one senior backend role, 95k ceiling. ingrid pls open it this week.

dzięki
M

Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: RE: backend capacity before the v3 push
messages.body:
ok good. I'll draft the technical profile with jonas and send it to ingrid before wednesday so the posting can go up end of week. must-haves: distributed queues, postgres at some scale, and someone who will actually ask about our failure modes in the interview instead of reciting buzzwords.

Cheers, Dev
